name: Taskbar
author: 0xEsmail
description: A Windows-style taskbar inside the Omarchy bar: pinned and running apps, click to switch or minimize, live window previews, jump-list menus, and no cursor jump when you click.

barWidget.description: Pinned and running apps; click to switch, hover to preview

schema.label: Window titles
schema.description: Show titles next to icons: none, focused app only, or every running app.

schema.label: Max title width
schema.description: Longest a title may get before it is cut off, in pixels.

schema.label: Show windows from
schema.description: all: every workspace. monitor: this monitor only. workspace: the visible workspace only.

schema.label: Click focused app to minimize
schema.description: Clicking an app whose only window already has focus minimizes it, like Windows.

schema.label: Live window previews
schema.description: Hovering a running app shows live thumbnails of its windows.

schema.label: Apps button
schema.description: A start-style button that opens the app grid. Right-click it for taskbar settings.

schema.label: Windows layout on first run
schema.description: The first time Taskbar loads, move the bar to the bottom, center Taskbar and put the clock in the corner. Happens once; shell.json is backed up first.
